reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E011 as a stuck/held-key condition, linked it to the wet-cleaning timing the customer volunteered, and led the homeowner through the exact fix (dry panel, isolate power at the cooker switch, retest) with sensible prevention advice and a conditional escalation only if it recurs. Conversation 1 ignored the volunteered clue about wet-cleaning the panel, asked irrelevant clock and child-lock questions, never mentioned drying or a power reset, and then wrongly concluded a selector/control fault needing an engineer visit for what was a no-part, self-fix problem. Conversation 2's minor flaws (speculative 'temperature sensor' and 'short circuit' wording) are far outweighed by Conversation 1's failed diagnosis and unnecessary escalation.
